groups.decision: Organization-issued seats, Business/Enterprise license, cloud feature scope and paid-agent eligibility are separate preconditions. Role metadata is not actual actor authorization.

Enterprise-selected enabled/disabled/selected-organization policy cannot be overridden locally. Third-party controls may be hidden until enterprise enablement; hidden UI requires inheritance review, not absent-control PASS.
Privacy/feature Policies and beyond-basic Models controls have different scope. Preserve possible extra cost and review effective enforcement independently of a dropdown choice.
Retain nested navigation, organization target selection and per-partner enablement toggle as procedures only. No menu visibility or documented click proves applied policy.

Copilot MCP policy is scoped to generally available support and excludes third-party-host GitHub MCP access/permissions. Review the GitHub MCP server's separate control mechanisms, preview scope and actual host path.
Organization agent apps use a distinct single policy, not Partner-agent toggles. Partners share cloud agent's enabled repository set; personal-account installed-app placement must not be generalized.

Feedback and previews need the stated plan plus Copilot-in-GitHub.com enablement. Feedback opportunities are not training consent; previews may have flaws/change/discontinuation and are not presumed generally available privacy coverage.
Default-model availability and supported policy surfaces remain separately linked dependencies; no linked page or platform surface is certified through a reference.

cross_scope_decisions: Personal installed agent apps and organizational agent apps have different governance paths; retain scope instead of reconciling by deleting an exception.
Provider hosting agreements, administrator model availability, MCP access permissions, feedback collection and training opt-out are independently governed.
Assess enterprise-selected effective policy before interpreting organization controls. Owner role does not defeat enterprise precedence.
Potential model costs are preserved; source ingestion does not authorize enablement or purchase.

proposed_effective_policy_review.native_changes: Scoped explicit approval with reviewed plan/diff/apply/verify and recovery receipts.

remaining_work: Full enterprise effective-policy and supported-surface review.
Separate GitHub MCP server governance source/target review within corpus and authority boundaries.
Model/feature availability and preview exception reconciliation.
Independent atomicity and omission audit, canonical profile/template applicability review.
Authorized effective target collection and scoped native behavior verification.
